## English

This directory contains architecture-specific machine-dependent code for the 4.5BSD kernel — sparc/sparc.

`config.mk` records 22 source file(s) here: `autoconf.c`, `auxreg.c`, `bsd_audiointr.s`, `cache.c`, `clock.c`, `conf.c`, `cpu.c`, `genassym.c`, `in_cksum.c`, `intr.c`, `kgdb_stub.c`, `locore.s`, ....

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.
